Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities joined to assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on assays.tid, molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno, and compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter to target CHEMBL1075094, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', pchembl_value not null. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
